name: Pace Marker
description: A competition-oriented silhouette with a sculpted midsole sidewall and a minimal heel. Finished in a two-tone upper. The Pebax midsole delivers responsive cushioning, while a carbon fibre plate adds stiffness for efficient energy transfer.
